## Setup

We have downloaded the complete GBIF database from https://gbif.org, and 
converted it to the parquet format to read only the partition of Madagascar
that corresponds to our area of interest. We fetch the protected area polygons
for Makay and Isalo from the World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) using the
 `wdpar` package. 

```{r}
library(arrow) # to read parquet
library(tidyverse) # for data manipulation
library(scales) # scale conversion
library(sf) # vector spatial data
library(tmap) # map visualization
library(wdpar) # to fetch protected areas

# define paths
wdpa_dir <- ("data/raw/wdpa")
parquet_dir <- ("data/parquet/gbif_madagascar")
# keep consistent colors across document
area_colors <- c(Makay = "#3b7a57", Isalo = "#c85c3e")

# create folder if needed
dir.create(wdpa_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# fetch WDPA
madagascar_wdpa <- wdpa_fetch("MDG", wait = TRUE, download_dir = wdpa_dir)

protected_areas <- madagascar_wdpa |>
  rename(geometry = SHAPE) |>
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry") |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  mutate(
    area = coalesce(NAME_ENG, NAME),
    # Area using laborde
    AREA_KM2 = as.numeric(st_area(st_transform(geometry, 29702))) / 1000000
  ) |>
  filter(str_detect(area, "Makay|Isalo")) |>
  st_transform(4326) 

# Define bounding boxes to read only gbif data within
bbox_matrix <- t(vapply(
  st_geometry(protected_areas),
  \(geometry) unname(st_bbox(geometry)),
  numeric(4)
))

colnames(bbox_matrix) <- c("xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax")


area_bboxes <- as_tibble(bbox_matrix) |>
  mutate(
    lon_bin_min = floor(xmin),
    lon_bin_max = floor(xmax),
    lat_bin_min = floor(ymin),
    lat_bin_max = floor(ymax)
  )

lon_bins <- seq(min(area_bboxes$lon_bin_min), max(area_bboxes$lon_bin_max))
lat_bins <- seq(min(area_bboxes$lat_bin_min), max(area_bboxes$lat_bin_max))

# columns to keep from gbif
required_columns <- c(
  "decimalLongitude",
  "decimalLatitude",
  "species",
  "scientificName",
  "year",
  "datasetName",
  "datasetKey",
  "institutionCode",
  "publishingOrgKey",
  "basisOfRecord",
  "class",
  "iucnRedListCategory",
  "genus",
  "family",
  "coordinateUncertaintyInMeters",
  "occurrenceStatus"
)

# compute total for Mada
madagascar_total <- open_dataset(parquet_dir) |>
  filter(is.na(occurrenceStatus) | occurrenceStatus == "PRESENT") |>
  summarise(total_records = n()) |>
  collect()

candidate_occurrences <- open_dataset(parquet_dir) |>
  select(any_of(c(required_columns, "lon_bin", "lat_bin"))) |>
  filter(
    lon_bin %in% lon_bins,
    lat_bin %in% lat_bins,
    !is.na(decimalLongitude),
    !is.na(decimalLatitude),
    is.na(occurrenceStatus) | occurrenceStatus == "PRESENT"
  ) |>
  collect()

for (column_name in setdiff(required_columns, names(candidate_occurrences))) {
  candidate_occurrences[[column_name]] <- NA
}

area_occurrences <- candidate_occurrences |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |>
  st_join(protected_areas |> select(area), join = st_within, left = FALSE) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(
    species_label = coalesce(species, scientificName),
    record_year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year))
  )

area_summary <- protected_areas |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  left_join(
    area_occurrences |>
      summarise(
        occurrence_count = n(),
        species_count = n_distinct(species_label, na.rm = TRUE),
        first_year = if (all(is.na(record_year))) NA_integer_ else min(record_year, na.rm = TRUE),
        last_year = if (all(is.na(record_year))) NA_integer_ else max(record_year, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = area
      ),
    by = "area"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    occurrence_count = coalesce(occurrence_count, 0L),
    species_count = coalesce(species_count, 0L),
    occurrence_density_per_100_km2 = occurrence_count / AREA_KM2 * 100,
    species_density_per_100_km2 = species_count / AREA_KM2 * 100
  )

filtering_steps <- tibble(
  step = c(
    "Madagascar present records",
    "Records inside the exact protected-area polygons"
  ),
  record_count = c(
    madagascar_total$total_records[[1]],
    nrow(area_occurrences)
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    share_of_madagascar = record_count / first(record_count)
  )

decade_counts <- area_occurrences |>
  filter(!is.na(record_year), between(record_year, 1800, as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")))) |>
  mutate(decade = (record_year %/% 10) * 10) |>
  summarise(occurrence_count = n(), .by = c(area, decade))

class_comparison <- area_occurrences |>
  distinct(area, class, species_label) |>
  filter(!is.na(class), !is.na(species_label)) |>
  count(area, class, name = "species_count")

top_classes <- class_comparison |>
  summarise(total_species = sum(species_count), .by = class) |>
  slice_max(total_species, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(total_species) |>
  pull(class)

class_plot_data <- class_comparison |>
  filter(class %in% top_classes) |>
  complete(area, class = top_classes, fill = list(species_count = 0)) |>
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = top_classes))

species_presence <- area_occurrences |>
  distinct(area, species_label) |>
  filter(!is.na(species_label))

shared_species_count <- species_presence |>
  count(species_label, name = "area_count") |>
  filter(area_count == 2) |>
  nrow()

unique_species <- species_presence |>
  add_count(species_label, name = "area_count") |>
  filter(area_count == 1) |>
  select(area, species_label)

species_union_count <- n_distinct(species_presence$species_label)
species_total_count <- nrow(species_presence)

overlap_metrics <- tibble(
  shared_species_count = shared_species_count,
  species_union_count = species_union_count,
  jaccard_similarity = if (species_union_count == 0) NA_real_ else shared_species_count / species_union_count,
  sorensen_similarity = if (species_total_count == 0) NA_real_ else 2 * shared_species_count / species_total_count
)

venn_polygons <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    x = -0.8 + 1.6 * cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    y = 1.6 * sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    set = "Isalo"
  ),
  tibble(
    x = 0.8 + 1.6 * cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    y = 1.6 * sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    set = "Makay"
  )
)
```

## Protected Areas

The PA is `r comma(round(area_summary$AREA_KM2[area_summary$area == "Makay"]))` km² for Makay and `r comma(round(area_summary$AREA_KM2[area_summary$area == "Isalo"]))` km² for Isalo.

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(protected_areas) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "area",
    palette = area_colors,
    alpha = 0.7,
    border.col = "#1f1f1f",
    lwd = 1.5,
    id = "area"
  ) +
  tm_text("area")
```

```{r}
area_summary |>
  transmute(
    area,
    area_km2 = round(AREA_KM2, 1),
    polygon_count = occurrence_count,
    species_count,
    occurrence_density_per_100_km2 = round(occurrence_density_per_100_km2, 1),
    species_density_per_100_km2 = round(species_density_per_100_km2, 1),
    first_year,
    last_year
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Protected-area size and exact-polygon GBIF summary")
```

## Madagascar GBIF and Filtering

The filtering workflow starts from all present GBIF records stored in the Madagascar parquet dataset, narrows the data to the parquet partitions touched by the two protected areas, and then keeps only points within the exact WDPA polygons.

```{r}
filtering_steps |>
  mutate(
    share_of_madagascar = percent(share_of_madagascar, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Filtering pipeline from Madagascar-wide GBIF data to the final protected-area occurrences")
```

```{r}
ggplot(area_summary, aes(x = area, y = occurrence_density_per_100_km2, fill = area)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(occurrence_density_per_100_km2, 1)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = area_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrence density inside each protected area",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Occurrences per 100 km²"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
ggplot(decade_counts, aes(x = decade, y = occurrence_count, fill = area)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ area, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = area_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrence history by decade",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Occurrence count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Class Representation

The figure below focuses on the twelve classes that contribute the most species across the two protected areas combined.

```{r}
ggplot(class_plot_data, aes(x = class, y = species_count, fill = area)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ area) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = area_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Species richness by class",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Species count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Species Overlap

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = venn_polygons,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = set, fill = set),
    color = "#1f1f1f",
    alpha = 0.45,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -1.9, y = 0, label = comma(sum(unique_species$area == "Isalo")), size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = comma(shared_species_count), size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.9, y = 0, label = comma(sum(unique_species$area == "Makay")), size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = -1.85, y = 1.85, label = "Isalo", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.85, y = 1.85, label = "Makay", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Isalo = area_colors[["Isalo"]], Makay = area_colors[["Makay"]])) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Species overlap between the two protected areas",
    subtitle = "Counts are based on distinct species labels after exact polygon filtering"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Jaccard similarity: `r percent(overlap_metrics$jaccard_similarity[[1]], accuracy = 0.1)`
